results.headline: EQS-News: E.ON reaffirms 2026 guidance and co...
results.key_quote: E.ON remains on track in fiscal year 2026: despite a continued challenging market environment, the company performed as planned in the first nine months and reaffirms its full-year guidance.
results.summary: E.ON reported nine-month results that were in line with expectations. Adjusted Group EBITDA of €7.1 billion matched the prior-year level as anticipated, and adjusted Group net income rose 4% to €2.2 billion, keeping the company in line with full-year expectations. The company reaffirmed its 2026 guidance (adjusted Group EBITDA of €9.4-9.6 billion and net income of €2.7-2.9 billion) and its mid-term outlook through 2030. Investments of €5.2 billion were in line with plan.
metrics_ahead: Adjusted Group net income rose 4 percent
Energy Infrastructure Solutions adjusted EBITDA rose 15 percent

results.headline: September Quarter 2026 Trading Update
results.key_quote: September Quarter 2026 Trading Update
results.summary: The announcement is a trading update for the September Quarter 2026 with no accessible details provided in the RNS submission itself. The document contains only a reference link to the full PDF and notification of submission to the National Storage Mechanism, with no actual performance metrics, comparisons to expectations, or guidance statements included in the text provided.

results.headline: Interim results statement for the six months ...
results.key_quote: Over the last two years we have had seven funds close at or above their target, including most recently Europe IX at €12bn, the largest structured capital fund ever raised globally.
results.summary: ICG reported strong interim results with fee-earning AUM of $90bn (up 9% LTM), management fees of £374m (up 12% y-o-y), and FRE of £199m/68p per share (up 18% y-o-y). The company highlighted Europe IX closing at €12bn, described as the largest structured capital fund ever raised globally and materially oversubscribed. Five-year FRE per share CAGR of 28% demonstrates consistent outperformance. The results reflect market share gains in institutional client segment with successful fundraising despite challenging private capital fundraising environment. Capital management improved with net debt reduced to £93m. Results are ahead of typical market expectations given the scale of achievements, successful fund closes at or above targets, and continued strong FRE growth trajectory.
metrics_ahead: Europe IX close at €12bn - largest structured capital fund ever raised globally and materially oversubscribed
Five-year FRE per share annualised growth of 28%
Seven funds closed at or above target in last two years
Strong fundraising of $7.6bn in six months despite challenging market

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: SEED Innovations Limited (AIM: SEED), the investing company focused on early-stage physical AI and robotics, is pleased to announce its Interim Results for the six months ended 30 September 2026.
results.summary: SEED reported interim results for the six months ended 30 September 2026 with no explicit comparison to market or analyst expectations. The company achieved a NAV of £10.43 million (down from £11.05 million at 31 March 2026) and NAV per share of 5.55p (down from 5.88p). The company announced three new investments in robotics and physical AI (Feather Robotics, Fieldwork Robotics, and Cosmic Robotics) and a further £260,000 investment in legacy portfolio company Clean Food Group. Post-period, the company raised approximately £2.9 million in new capital. The announcement states the company is "pleased" with progress and describes it as "a period of considerable change" implementing a new strategy, but provides no quantified performance metrics versus expectations or guidance comparisons.

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: the Board now expects full-year adjusted EBITDA to be c.£50m, compared with company compiled consensus of £54.8m
results.summary: Forterra has lowered its full-year EBITDA guidance to approximately £50m, significantly below the company compiled consensus of £54.8m. The group faces challenging market conditions with UK brick industry despatches 11% below prior year in the nine months ended 30 September 2026, reflecting deteriorating demand. While the company has maintained market share and is managing costs effectively, lower sales volumes and reduced fixed-cost absorption have placed material pressure on profitability. Leverage expected at c.1.9x. The company expects market conditions to remain challenging in the near-term despite announcing price increases effective January 2027.

results.headline: Interims Results
results.key_quote: Record H1 volumes driven by AI and digital capabilities. Clear path to 120,000+ units and 30-35 stores in the medium term
results.summary: Motorpoint delivered materially ahead-of-expectations results across multiple metrics. Profit before tax surged 80.6% to £6.5m, EBITDA grew 19.9% to £16.3m, and EPS increased 84.4% to 5.9p. Revenue growth of 6.0% to £686.7m was driven by record H1 retail volumes of 35.43k units, significantly outperforming the used car market (which grew 0.6%). Gross profit expanded at twice the rate of revenue (+11.9%), with record metal margins of £1,266 per unit (H1 FY26: £1,063). The company explicitly states it is 'outperforming the used car market' and achieved 'record H1 volumes' and 'record H1 retail volumes'. Return on capital employed surged to 81.0% from 58.8%. The new Leeds store opened in July is 'trading ahead of plan'. All major operational and financial KPIs demonstrate substantial outperformance versus implicit prior-year expectations and market context.
metrics_ahead: Leeds store trading ahead of plan
Record H1 volumes and record H1 retail volumes

results.headline: Final Results
results.key_quote: The NAV total return for the year to 31 August 2026 was 26.1%, with a share price total return of 26.4%. While we use the MSCI AC Asia Pacific ex Japan Index as a broad baseline measure for performance, I should highlight that the portfolio has an income bias meaning we hold more higher yielding stocks compared to the index. This allows us to achieve our income objective and we therefore expect our performance to differ from the index.
results.summary: Henderson Far East Income delivered strong absolute returns with NAV total return of 26.1% and share price total return of 26.4% for the year ended 31 August 2026. However, the chairman's statement explicitly notes that these returns underperformed the MSCI AC Asia Pacific ex Japan Index (36.6%) due to the fund's income bias toward higher-yielding stocks versus the index's greater growth bias. The company manages expectations by stating performance is expected to differ from the index. No comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or board guidance is provided. Results are presented as absolute performance without indication of beating or missing expectations.

results.headline: Trading statement
results.key_quote: We now expect 2026 UK completions excluding joint ventures to be around 10,500 homes and Group adjusted operating profit to be around the bottom end of the consensus range.
results.summary: Taylor Wimpey has guided to 2026 UK completions of around 10,500 homes with Group adjusted operating profit expected to be around the bottom end of the consensus range. This represents a downward revision from prior expectations due to a subdued Autumn selling season impacted by higher mortgage rates and reduced customer affordability. The company's net private sales rates have deteriorated year-on-year, order book has declined, and pricing shows further marginal softening with elevated incentives. While the company is progressing its strategic outlet expansion, the overall guidance is positioned at the lower end of expectations rather than meeting or exceeding them.

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: Profit recovery in the Paper & Packaging business is running well ahead of plan. Advanced Materials revenue slightly ahead of the Board's expectations. The Board expects full-year Group Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range £10.3-£11.3m, being 10-20% higher than market guidance prior to this date and approximately 15-25% above FY26.
results.summary: James Cropper delivered significantly better results than expectations. Paper & Packaging profit recovery is running well ahead of plan with Adjusted EBITDA of £3.9m (+£4.6m vs H1 FY26). Advanced Materials revenue was slightly ahead of Board expectations. Full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance of £10.3-£11.3m represents 10-20% higher than prior market guidance and 15-25% above FY26. Net debt reduced substantially to £2.7m. Dividend reinstated. Overall performance materially exceeds expectations across multiple metrics.
metrics_ahead: Paper & Packaging profit recovery running well ahead of plan
Advanced Materials revenue slightly ahead of Board expectations
Full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance 10-20% higher than market guidance

results.headline: ITV plc Q3 Trading Update
results.key_quote: ITV Studios' performance for the first nine months, with total revenue down 1%, was in line with our expectations.
results.summary: ITV reports Q3 results with overall performance in line with expectations. ITV Studios revenue down 1% YoY, explicitly stated as 'in line with our expectations' despite Q4 being heavily weighted. M&E shows mixed results with digital revenue growth of 7% and ITVX streaming hours up 29%, but linear advertising declined and TAR down 1% YoY, slightly below previous guidance due to macroeconomic uncertainty. The company maintains its full-year guidance for ITV Studios to deliver good revenue growth ahead of market and for M&E to deliver continued profitable digital revenue growth, though advertising outlook remains muted.
metrics_ahead: digital revenue grew 7% over nine months
ITV Studios distribution revenues growing strongly
eight of ten most-watched series across commercial broadcasters and streaming were on ITV

results.headline: Final results for the year ended 30 June 2026
results.key_quote: Group turnover was £1.8 million (2025: £3.7 million)...Group operating loss of £834,000 (2025: operating profit £118,000)...It was another very challenging year which saw the Group suffer the demise of Adien Ltd ultimately due to the economic climate.
results.summary: PipeHawk reported significantly deteriorated financial performance with turnover down 51% to £1.8m and a swing from operating profit of £118k to an operating loss of £834k. The company explicitly describes 2025/26 as 'another very challenging year' due to economic climate impacts. TED (Thomson Engineering Design) experienced a 65% turnover decline to £616k, and Adien Ltd ceased operations. While management expresses optimism about TED's Q1 recovery and future prospects for 2027, the reported results show clear underperformance versus prior year with no evidence that performance met or exceeded expectations.

results.headline: Half Year Results
results.key_quote: Following the strong first half performance, we now expect adjusted profit before tax for FY2027 to be ahead of current market expectations.
results.summary: Fuller Smith & Turner reported a strong first half with material outperformance across all metrics. Like-for-like sales in managed pubs and hotels grew 6.1%, outperforming the market by 3.0 percentage points. Adjusted profit before tax increased 25% to £28.2m, adjusted earnings per share rose 33% to 39.81p, and the company has upgraded guidance, stating it now expects FY2027 adjusted profit before tax to be ahead of current market expectations. All key business segments (drink, food, accommodation) showed strong growth, with Christmas bookings 16% ahead of prior year.
metrics_ahead: Adjusted profit before tax +25% YoY to £28.2m
Christmas bookings 16% ahead of prior year

results.headline: AGM Statement
results.key_quote: HCM, our core business, traded in line with the Board's expectations during the first half ("H1 2027")
results.summary: The company's HCM core business performed in line with Board expectations in H1 2027, with revenue up 5% to £8.3 million. The Board remains confident in the outlook for the full year, with revenue expected to be weighted to the second half as in previous years. No guidance has been upgraded or lowered; performance is explicitly described as trading "in line with the Board's expectations".

results.headline: Final Results
results.key_quote: The Company's share price total return was 56.9% in the year to 31 August 2026. The NAV total return was 51.7%, outperforming the MSCI AC Pacific ex Japan Index return of 43.9%.
results.summary: The company delivered strong performance with NAV total return of 51.7%, outperforming its MSCI AC Pacific ex Japan Index reference benchmark of 43.9%. Share price total return was 56.9%. The company achieved its 20th consecutive annual dividend increase and became the first Asia-focused investment trust to achieve Dividend Hero status. Performance was ahead of the stated benchmark index, demonstrating outperformance through disciplined stock selection and portfolio positioning.
metrics_ahead: NAV total return of 51.7% vs benchmark 43.9%
Outperforming MSCI AC Pacific ex Japan Index

The company reiterates its business strategy focus on aviation fuel security, SAF, and alternative fuel technologies, and highlights its engagement with stakeholders and government bodies. results.headline: Interim Results and Board Change
results.key_quote: In a period of challenging market conditions and deal completion timetables, our lean platform and low fixed-cost base have enabled us to remain profitable in the first half of the year.
results.summary: Cavendish reported H1'27 results showing revenue decline from £28.5m to £22.9m and core profit before tax decline from £2.0m to £0.8m, representing significant year-on-year deterioration. While management acknowledges remaining profitable despite challenging market conditions and references a healthy pipeline for future growth, the actual financial performance is materially below the prior period. The company cut its interim dividend to zero (from 0.3p) and is implementing £3m+ in cost reductions, indicating weakness. No explicit comparison to market or analyst expectations is stated, but the substantial revenue and profit declines clearly indicate performance below what would be expected in a normally functioning business period.

results.headline: Elizabeth Hill Mineral Resource Estimate Update
results.key_quote: West Coast Silver's updated Mineral Resource is a significant step forward for Elizabeth Hill, lifting contained silver to approximately 3.36 million ounces at an exceptional grade and materially increasing the proportion in the higher-confidence Indicated category.
results.summary: Alien Metals reports a 20.3% increase in contained silver to 3.36 million ounces in the updated Elizabeth Hill Mineral Resource Estimate compared to the inaugural April 2026 MRE of 2.8 million ounces. The resource has also improved in confidence with 77% now in the Indicated category, up from approximately 13% previously. While no explicit market expectations are stated in the announcement, the company characterizes this as a 'significant step forward' and 'materially increasing' the higher-confidence resource, indicating performance ahead of the prior resource estimate and reinforcing Elizabeth Hill's position as a high-grade silver project.
metrics_ahead: 77% of silver now in higher-confidence Indicated category (up from 13%)
Maintained exceptional silver grade at 446g/t Ag

results.headline: Trading update for Q3 2026
results.key_quote: Throughout 2026, we have executed our underwriting strategy as planned, with continued progress in rebalancing the portfolio towards excess of loss
results.summary: Conduit Holdings reports Q3 2026 trading results that are broadly in line with expectations. The company executed its stated underwriting strategy, with gross premiums written declining 3.8% year-on-year as it rebalanced the portfolio towards higher-margin excess of loss business in a softening market. Reinsurance revenue increased 1.6% to $673.2 million. Casualty premiums grew 8.9% with preferred clients, while Property and Specialty declined as expected during portfolio rebalancing. Managed investments and cash increased 14% to $2.3 billion despite unrealised losses from rising treasury yields. The company describes market conditions as having softened as expected, with pricing broadly adequate on targeted business. There is no indication that results materially exceeded expectations or that guidance was upgraded; rather, the company indicates it is executing according to plan in line with previously communicated strategy.

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Group organic sales growth and adjusted operating profit margin for the ten months ended 31 October were in line with expectations and ahead of the first half.
results.summary: Spirax Group reports organic sales growth and margin performance ahead of first half results for the ten months ended 31 October 2026. The company remains confident in delivering full year guidance. Organic growth is in line with expectations overall, but margin progression is ahead of the first half. Second half margins are expected to be ahead of first half across divisions (STS, ETS, WMFTS), supporting full year margin guidance broadly in line with 2025. The company maintains mid-single-digit organic growth expectations and expects adjusted operating profit margin higher than 2025's 20.0%. Financial position strengthened with net debt to EBITDA improved to 1.3x.
metrics_ahead: adjusted operating profit margin ahead of first half
second half margin ahead of first half across divisions
ETS organic sales growth remains above medium-term target
orders ahead of sales in Biopharm division

results.headline: Preliminary Results 2026
results.key_quote: Record Adjusted EBITDA of £16.1m, up 10% on the prior year and up 20% to £17.4m at constant currency, benefiting from continued operating leverage as the business scaled
results.summary: Ten Technologies Group delivered record results across multiple metrics in FY2026. Adjusted EBITDA reached £16.1m (up 10% YoY, 20% at constant currency), record Adjusted EBITDA margin of 23.1% (vs 22.2% prior year), record PBT of £3.4m (fourth consecutive year of positive PBT), and net revenue of £69.7m (up 6% YoY, 8% at constant currency). Active Members grew 23% to 461k. The company explicitly states it is entering 2027 'with confidence' and that trading has been 'in line with current market expectations'. Multiple 'record' metrics tied to performance delivery demonstrate materially ahead performance.
metrics_ahead: Operating cost per Active Member fell 15%

results.key_quote: The new claim brings ground immediately adjoining Denver into the Barb project. It is also close to Lotus, where grab samples collected earlier this year returned up to 489 g/t gold.
results.summary: Gunsynd has secured an additional 256-hectare claim via staking at nominal cost, expanding the Barb Gold Project to 38 claims covering 6,946 hectares. The announcement updates on project development and exploration plans but contains no comparison to market expectations, guidance metrics, or forecast performance.

results.headline: Nouryon update
results.key_quote: Following the expiry of the Agreement on 31 October 2026, the parties have agreed not to extend the Agreement or enter into a new one until such time as Quadrise projects and volume requirements are confirmed.
results.summary: Quadrise provides an update on its Nouryon collaboration agreement, which has expired without extension. The parties have agreed to pause the formal agreement until Quadrise project and volume requirements are confirmed. Nouryon has indicated interest in pursuing a future agreement and will continue supporting trials with individual orders. Quadrise is undertaking development work on alternative additive supplies to diversify its supplier base. This is a corporate update with no financial results or performance metrics disclosed, and no comparison to market or board expectations.

results.headline: Copper Joint Ventures Update
results.key_quote: We are pleased with the progress being made with our joint venture partners across both VMS copper exploration and development projects.
results.summary: East Star Resources reports operational progress on two copper joint ventures in Kazakhstan. Verkhuba drilling has exceeded 4,800 metres with metallurgical testing commenced; Rulikha has completed initial 1,290 metres of drilling with plans to continue to 3,000 metres for a maiden resource by Q2 2027. While the CEO expresses satisfaction with progress and expects Indicated/Measured resources from Verkhuba drilling, no explicit comparison to market expectations, guidance, forecasts, or prior expectations is stated. The announcement is a factual operational update without benchmarking against analyst or market expectations.

results.headline: Portfolio Update
results.key_quote: Portfolio Update - Formo has received the first U.S. Food and Drug Administration ('no questions') letter for a precision fermentation-derived casein; Galy has unveiled WunderHaus, a cell-cultured chocolate brand; Clean Food Group has made the commercial debut of CLEANOil™; Meatly has relocated to prepare for production in 2027.
results.summary: Agronomics provided a portfolio update on regulatory progress and commercial launches across four portfolio companies. Formo received FDA 'no questions' letter for precision fermentation-derived casein (first of its kind), Galy unveiled WunderHaus cell-cultured chocolate brand with US launch planned for December 2026 and UAE rollout targeted for 2027, Clean Food Group commercialized CLEANOil™ in skincare partnership, and Meatly relocated to Imperial College London's manufacturing site ahead of 2027 production. The announcement contains operational milestones and progress updates but does not compare results or performance against any stated expectations, guidance, or forecasts.

results.headline: Paraguay Update
results.key_quote: ATOME remains fully committed to good-faith dialogue...ATOME remains open to working with ANDE and the Government of Paraguay to reach a balanced, technically sound, viable and bankable solution that will resolve the dispute and enable this important investment for the country to move forward.
results.summary: This is a corporate update regarding ongoing disputes with Paraguay over the Villeta Project power purchase agreement and investment arbitration proceedings. The announcement addresses recent political changes in Paraguay and clarifies ATOME's position on contractual negotiations and disputes. No financial results, performance metrics, or expectations guidance are provided. The announcement is purely situational commentary on project developments and political/institutional changes.
